edits.text: 1. POSITION. The Executive shall serve as Chief Operating Officer, reporting to the Chief Executive Officer or such other person as the Board may designate.

2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive the Base Salary set out below, together with participation in the Company’s benefit plans generally available to senior executives, subject to the terms and conditions of such plans.
3. SEVERANCE. On termination without cause, subject to the Executive’s execution and non-revocation of a customary release, the Executive shall receive the Severance Amount set out below.
4. NON-COMPETE. The Executive shall not compete for twelve months after departure, to the extent permitted by applicable law and subject to any required limitations.
